title: approvals: recall and the subflow-parent strand report resumeFailure without the hook refusal (innerRefusal, userMessage)
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQ2SN4K183oqAvUajA

Filing gate ①: contract review N2 on PR #34619 (Fixes #34579, review 6938300180), passed on by area `o2-H`. Dedupe: `resumeFailure innerRefusal recall`; no open card.

Suggested-grade: p2 · domain:server

## 维护者速读

- 现象:#34579 之后，审批决定门(通过、驳回等)在下一步被钩子拒绝时，错误体会带上拒绝原文和那句给用户看的话。但「撤回」这扇门，以及子流程把父流程卡住的那条路，是用成功响应里的 `resumeFailure` 报告「运行卡住了」,里面没有这两项，用户仍看不到为什么。
- 为什么要修：同一种「被钩子拒绝而卡住」,从不同的门进来，用户能看到的信息不一样。
- 需要你做的：无(分诊定级;要不要给 `ResumeFailureReport` 加这两项，若属契约放宽按常规走契约复审)。

## Observed (by review)

The refusal reaches only the thrown `RESUME_FAILED` envelope. The recall door and the subflow-parent strand report a stranded run on a success answer through `resumeFailure` (`ResumeFailureReport`), which carries no `innerRefusal` / `userMessage`. The spec text already separates the two channels.

## Question for the card

Should `ResumeFailureReport` carry the same pair (`innerRefusal`, `userMessage`) so every door that strands a run on a hook refusal tells the caller why?

## Premise check (run first)

On main after #34619 merges: an approval flow whose step after recall (or a subflow whose parent resumes into a refusing hook) is refused by a record hook. Read the recall answer's `resumeFailure`. If it already carries the refusal, close this card.
